lines.speaker: Dennis
lines.text: The Chief Executive went on a retreat. Came back talking about strategic patience.

lines.speaker: Dennis
lines.text: It is when you are not doing anything, but on purpose. Nobody on our floor has heard it yet.
Dennis buys a round and claims it as stakeholder engagement. You are the stakeholder.
You get to the front early. The only other person here is from Facilities, testing the chairs.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: They've got a new north star this year. It's on the slides.

lines.speaker: Facilities
lines.text: Couldn't tell you. You're not meant to get there. You just face it.

title: A demonstration, in the fourth-floor corridor

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: Every department currently has its own numbers. With us, you have a single source of truth.

lines.speaker: Salesperson
lines.text: Yours, when I'm talking to you.
